fields.Name: inputs
fields.Description: The inputs the model reads. Declared on the abstract Model root because it holds for every descendant without exception — a model with no inputs is not a model. Unbounded, and each filled position is a component in its own right, so an input carries its own story and can be found and reused on meaning rather than on column name.

fields.Name: weights
fields.Description: The named weights (with modes, caps, floors) the rubric combines. Fillable by a hand-authored set or a search-fitted one.

fields.Name: bands
fields.Description: Optional qualitative tiers applied to the rubric’s score.

fields.Name: base_estimator
fields.Description: The model to bootstrap-replicate. Any Model descendant — including a reused trained component (frozen).

fields.Name: estimators
fields.Description: The level-0 models whose outputs the final estimator learns to combine.

fields.Name: final_estimator
fields.Description: The glass-box combiner over the level-0 outputs.
